name: diagram-details
title: Diagram details: every zone, label, count, edge and host count she asks for
description: Detailed drawing requests on real providers: zones with labels and per-zone devices, a VLSM plan with host counts, a flowchart, a tree, and edits that add to or replace part of a diagram. The board checks name each detail she asked for (labels, icon counts per group, edges between named nodes, usable hosts per zone), so a diagram that skips half the request fails.

turns.student: Draw an office network with three zones: Sales, Engineering and Guest Wi-Fi. Each zone has its own switch and two PCs. Every zone switch connects to a Core Switch, and the Core Switch connects to a router labeled Edge Router.
Add a file server labeled NAS to Engineering and one laptop to Guest Wi-Fi. Keep everything else as it is.
Now draw a separate VLSM plan for 192.168.10.0/24 as zones: Sales needs 50 hosts, HR needs 20 hosts and IT needs 10 hosts. Write each zone's CIDR under its name.
Draw a flowchart for logging in: Start, then Enter password, then a decision Password correct?. If yes, Show dashboard, then End. If no, Show error and go back to Enter password.
Draw a binary search tree with 8 at the root, 3 and 10 as its children, 1 and 6 under 3, and 14 under 10.
In the office network, replace the Guest Wi-Fi zone with a DMZ zone that holds a web server. Leave Sales and Engineering exactly as they are.
